statement: B300 cloud rental is quoted at a median of $8.13 per GPU-hour across 13 provider configurations, starting at $7.39
why: Shows the going rental rate for the newest accelerator, but with no earlier rate given it is a level, not a move.

impact.mechanism: Rental rate is the operating cost reference for renters of current-generation capacity; no baseline stated so no direction can be read.

evidence.source: aggregated web search (IntuitionLabs, GPU Battle, JarvisLabs, getdeploying.com)
evidence.excerpt: B300 cloud rental quoted starting at $7.39/GPU-hr with median $8.13/hr across 13 provider configs

confidence.basis: Secondary aggregator listing across providers; no as-of date on the underlying pages.

dispersion: Starting $7.39/hr vs median $8.13/hr across 13 provider configurations.
